title: Grace period is underspecified: no bounds, error codes, or client signal
description: Section 6 allows an 'implementation-defined grace period' with no duration bounds, no error code returned when access is denied post-grace-period, and no client-observable signal when the grace period ends. Clients are told to 'treat the file tree as potentially inaccessible' which is not actionable. Specify: what error does FileNode/set return after the grace period? Does the server send a push notification when it ends?
